note: ADR-0500 withdraws URL-in-`--database` and makes it a usage error, so I would accept the remote bundle URL through `--load` instead, reusing ADR-0496's carried-over fetch rules (GitHub rewrite, https and loopback policy, `.cl` requirement, capped streaming stage), with a scratch copy removed after load.

Implement `query [STATEMENT] [--database PATH]` as a first-positional statement-session verb (not exit-after), with `:memory:` as the default store, one shared options block for `--help`, and the existing did-you-mean behavior on usage errors.

Add the new procedure with no database argument (it acts on the session or USE database), put it behind the `ontology` preview gate with the other four, keep it always built and listed in SHOW PROCEDURES, and follow the implicit/explicit transaction rules that match whether it reads or writes.

Extend the re-arrival trail-existence rule in the frontier NFA kernel and bound its work with a run-time budget that falls through to the DFS, keeping the structural and answer-shape gates and the `auto` routing unchanged.

Add post-verb `--read-only` and `--follow` to `serve`, opening one shared ReadOnly or Follow handle for all surfaces including `serve --mcp` (the standalone MCP bin is retired, so clause 8 of ADR-0306 no longer applies), and make the Docker entrypoint forward both as valueless flags.

Implement the `snapshot DATABASE --to|--from FILE.cl` exit-after verb with a read-only source open, a non-existent destination that is cleaned up on failure, no codec conversion, the two `Database` methods, and no new Cargo feature.
